# The commands on docs/FLOWS_GETTING_STARTED.html, in the page's order, each once: the page shows these and no other
# (Skills.test_the_getting_started_page_shows_the_listed_commands_only). Every one was run in the M5 pilot or with
# it, as written here; a <placeholder> stands for one argument. FLOWS_PILOT_LOG=<the pilot's commands.log> checks
# that against the log (Skills.test_every_listed_page_command_is_in_the_pilots_command_log), which stays outside
# the repository. A line ending in "# not run in the pilot" is the exception (the install line and the two skills),
# and the page says so next to each place it shows it.
mkdir -p $SCRATCH/out
orca orchestration run-create --objective "flows M5 smoke pilot" --json
python3 $R init
orca worktree create --name flows-pilot --repo path:<the repository's main checkout> --base-branch origin/orca-router --setup skip --no-parent --json
python3 $R flow apply $SCRATCH/flow.json --dry-run
python3 $R flow apply $SCRATCH/flow.json --by m5-worker --note "the M5 smoke pilot"
python3 $R page --open
python3 $R flow show
python3 $R wait --timeout-min 8
python3 $R reply msg_8dd7dea7db5e PASS
python3 $R retry smoke1 --note "write the word OK into flaky.txt in the target directory"
python3 $R resume smoke1
python3 $R status
orca snapshot --page <page id>
orca click --page <page id> --element <Edit the flow>
orca drag --page <page id> --from <flaky chip> --to <record chip>
orca click --page <page id> --element <Apply…>
orca fill --page <page id> --element <why> --value pilot-drag-1
orca click --page <page id> --element <Apply as v2>
python3 $R collect --all --force
python3 $R collect --dry-run
python3 $R report --metrics $ROUTER_STATE/metrics.json
orca tab create --url file://$ROUTER_STATE/report.html --json
/flows:flow-report  # not run in the pilot
/flows:flow-plan  # not run in the pilot
python3 $R stop --all
orca worktree rm --worktree path:<the worktree's path> --json
orca orchestration --help
python3 --version
/plugin install flows@dimakrest-context-engineering  # not run in the pilot
python3 $R flow apply <file> --dry-run
python3 $R flow apply <file> --by <you> --note "<why>"
python3 $R flow history
python3 $R wait --timeout-min <n>
python3 $R reply <id> "<answer>"
python3 $R retry <pr> --note "<why>"
python3 $R resume <pr>
python3 $R collect --all
python3 $R report
